# rustinion_permission_grant (Resource)

Manages one fine-grained permission grant: overrides a user's org/department role for a single kind of resource, in a single scope. A grant only applies to a user who already holds a role in this tenant (it never confers membership on its own) and never overrides a global admin. See permissions.rs in the main repo for the full resolution order.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `permission_level` (String) One of "read", "write", or "admin". Updates in place — the API upserts on the grant's own scope, so changing a level never destroys and recreates the grant (which would briefly restore the user's unrestricted role-level access).
- `resource_type` (String) One of "alert_rules", "dashboards", "synthetic_checks", or "notification_channels". Changing this names a different grant, so it forces replacement.
- `user_id` (String) The user this grant applies to (`users.id`). Reference `rustinion_user.example.user_id` — **not** that resource's `id`, which is its `user_roles` row id. Changing this names a different grant, so it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `group_id` (String) Scope this grant to one group. Omit for a tenant-wide grant covering every group, the same convention a user's own org-level role uses. Changing this names a different grant, so it forces replacement.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Server-assigned grant ID.
